title: Faded portrait
description: Tinted, faded, grainy and scratched. Restoring the tones reveals hidden grain, which a later step removes.

title: Sepia launch
description: A sepia print. Lifting the faded blacks makes faint scratches visible, so the agent adds a repair it didn't plan at the start.

title: Grainy street photo
description: Heavy film grain on a black-and-white print. Denoising uncovers scratches hidden under the grain.

title: Warm café table
description: Grainy, with warm highlights but intact blacks. Is that ageing or real coffee colour? The agent asks you.

title: Badly damaged cat
description: Dense scratches and dust over a large area. The agent won't invent that much of the photo without your approval.

title: Undamaged control
description: Nothing wrong with this one. A good restorer leaves it alone, and so does ReVive.
